preconditions.description: Contract must have ETH balance (from previous mints or deposits)
Attacker needs enough ETH to pay for at least 1 NFT mint (0.05 ETH)
Public mint must be enabled (public_mint_status == true)

exploit_hint: Create a malicious contract with a reentrant fallback/receive function. Call the mint() function with quantity=1, paying 0.05 ETH. During the _safeMint call, the contract will call onERC721Received on your malicious contract. In that callback, recursively call mint() again before the withdraw() function transfers funds. This allows multiple mints while only paying once, draining the contract's ETH balance to the treasuryWallet through repeated withdraw() calls.
